entries.description: Conversation summary carries link text without the [linked] marker
Always talk to the public site (Google sign-in rejects the api tunnel origin); loader never browser-cached
One kept-alive connection pool (no fresh TCP+TLS per turn)
NamedWork returns a filtered copy of the work
Commentary by author/form markers is not scripture; add missed Jain/Avestan/Five Classics canon; intros are scholarship
Concept layer honours scope filters; question subject ends at the asking sentence
Tools API sets its key before imports (tools.js now loads config via authority.js); prayer dispatcher logs the several-traditions occasion choice first
No Jafar on SifterSearch — remove the four Jafar chat docs, point chat references to Anís
Keepalive wired into /stream and /v1/chat; Jafar prompt and ANIS_PROMPT rollback removed; quote hunt takes the words out of 'where does X say ...'
/docs/response-strategies builds from the strategy DB, drawing each strategy's newest tree
Count the fallback ordinal only when the MD has no para_N
Lift the five lookups (book, quote_trace, term, original, about) out of Unmatched into their own strategies
Unmatched runtime (reuse / Haiku recheck / on-the-fly Opus candidate design, fallback to researcher) + spoken progress lines for live channels
Stall line carries pid + uptime so boot-time stalls are told apart from request-time ones; budget ledger: writings-authors write
Anís improvement process redesign — measured causes of the $312 run (truncation retry storm, 10% dedupe, 1% yield) and a frozen-eval, class-level loop under $5/day
Author field — the model names the writer, code resolves it; a name left in a no-planner query was only words (SAQ 77 missed)

Retire Strategies & Activities — its content now lives on three layered pages: Tools (registry merged with the plan, planned tools), Response Strategies (the strategy of strategies, question classes A1–H2 with served-by, building steps, composition, decisions), Activities (reader activities with linked steps); /docs/anis-strategies 301s to /docs/response-strategies; builder script removed
Deterministic markdown validity on every reply (nested link, unbalanced emphasis, broken link) → WRITER malformed-markdown, free
11-04 late night state (credit outage, deploys, HyPE backlog)
Qdrant 10 ms — per-collection measurements and ranked proposals (11-04, read-only)
11-04 night search latency + quote citation status, index proposals for Chad
Hydration off the event loop — synchronous SQLite reads were inflating Qdrant wall time ~10x
Retire cleanup skips concepts + phrases_hot (left for later; indexers already skip excluded docs)
The subject is the question without the names it compares (thread name spans), searched per side and inside the named book
Each side searched with the question and its subject, kept to its own tradition; Jev names each side's book and it is read first
Anís site-chat latency breakdown before/after (first text W3 6.4 s, W8 9.4 s p50; quality gate fails: W3 14/27, W8 14/42)

HyPE and concept layers use a plain top-(limit×2) Qdrant query grouped per paragraph here (like phrases), escalating ×4 then /query/groups — measured hype 3.7 vs 7.8 ms, concepts 4.4 vs 7.0 ms server, recall@10 unchanged or better
Talk feedback popup on the player page
Correct gets guard 2 (its fp changes, so talks corrected under the old guard are stale); clean and render declare after: correct — a correct re-run rewrites transcript.work.json, so both redo
Jev's deep-report fields (depth, accepts_offer) ride triage's jevCall — retried once within budget, timeouts reported
Tools API live (17 tools at /api/v1/tools/<name>, spec at /api/v1/docs)
Tools are one OpenAPI API (POST /api/v1/tools/<name>, plain JSON outputs, chainable)
Contextual Awareness Tools (calendar_lookup, occasion_search; not built)
One canonical name per tool (_search takes words, _lookup takes a known item); old names listed as aliases
Quotation trace is a strategy (phrase + literal search, Jev holds check, passage_links), not a tool; passage_links listed as the tool
Research Tools rebuilt from the real tool inventory — each search kind its own tool, function + endpoint per tool, gaps and naming conflicts listed
Research Tools lists each search as its own tool and subsection (Keyword/BM25, Semantic, HyPE, Prepared Knowledge)
Research Tools (Search + Prepared Knowledge now under it), Complex Activities; renumbered to 10 sections
Data Widgets folded into Response Strategies; Hyper-Engagement is section 10 (its parts by name, linking the full doc)

Sections ordered by importance — Purpose+Outcome Goal, Personality, Modes, User Card, Tools, Activities (+Scenario Types), Response Strategies (types+speed), Self-Improvement, Search (BM25/semantic/HyPE/prepared), Data Widgets, Testing and Evidence
No role system — section 4 is Scenario Types (examples of use, with the sample exchanges) and Scenario Recognition; role wording removed
Deadline + empty-result degrade for slow library search; F15 chat kill switch and per-person/global hourly caps (with tests)
No implementation details (index/method names, test-set names, dates of internal rules) — plain concepts only
Laya removed for now (a cost saving for a system that must work first)
Anís voice likely ships as a standalone app
Prose tightened; quotation trace framed as an example strategy
Compact graphical strategy chart (no brackets), body text softened so bold stands out, strategy section tightened
Models by role, re-measured when the monthly review flags a newer/cheaper candidate

Every chain input is Opus — video, MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC alike (Chad 11-03: "everything is converted to Opus, even video or MP3. The original file is kept and the metadata extracted, but we only process Opus.")
A pod is rented only for work it can claim — LAN-only gpu hours are not pod work, no rent when the edge has nothing claimable (11-03)
No decoded audio is ever processed — a WAV/FLAC/AIFF original is always planned for Opus; a decoded chain is refused or repaired (11-03)
The LAN queue no longer gets home_gpu:false — pods never lease from the LAN, so it stranded the LAN-only gpu steps (394, decoded inputs) with Aorus idle
A result tower has read becomes 'collected' and leaves the done list (files kept until ack)
Anís demo plan (9 Nov) — target, baseline, staged metrics, acceptance tests, schedule
Qdrant-main cutover done (gate PASS, qdrant-next stopped, data kept to 11-09); entity-aware ranking item open
A talk R2 refuses as over its single-upload limit is skipped (sent to its pod direct) instead of failing every tick (11-02: a 15 GB .mpg 'whole' at the head of the line blocked all staging)
Comparative (multi-tradition) question versions, every side scored
Search quality hub — one question registry (survey families), one runner, one gate, HyPE coverage, feedback intake
Siftersearch-reports (which runs the archive jobs) stays inside the capped bulk slice (Chad 11-02: search is top priority)
Hype collection keeps full vectors in RAM (on_disk false, applied live 11-02: hype x6 0.38→0.18 s, x30 1.4→0.55 s)
Bahai-library tag index pages excluded from every search (Anís cited 'Tag: …' pages); phrase+hype rescore oversampling 4→2 (measured 29–30/30 top-30 agreement, half the disk reads)

Under SEARCH_QDRANT=only, multiIndexSearch without meili:false runs the flat Qdrant form — the retired Meili main layer had been routing to qdrantClassic, a whole nested multiIndexSearch (two fan-outs, rankings and hydrations per search; chat executeSearch and the Anís agent called it that way)

Canon and authoritative passes start with the first wave instead of after it (canon p50 788 ms, its own query 15–105 ms); query embedding stamped as 'embed' in the trace so a slow layer splits into Gemini vs Qdrant
Anís round 9 done; next = speaker attribution, links, citation order
Anís round 9 state at laptop shutdown; citation source order (Chad 11-01)
Anís wording battery → then simulated-conversation quality loop (Chad 10-31)
Deterministic quotation hunt (quote shape overrides Jev topic), plan provenance on the thread, honest absence on a quote miss, search tracing restored on the live path
A flipped remaster tower cannot finish goes to a worker; a requeue orders the worker remaster
A talk outside 'done' carries no published_at. The repo clears it on every state write that leaves done, and the verify pass repairs the past rows once per pass.
Published = on air. published_at follows restored in the repo; the catalogue no longer stamps it.

Pods ramp on talks out, not the plan; a media-scan yields to a drain; media_items.source_ref indexed. (1) LH.podOutput: over the plan horizon, audio adopted from pod gpu steps + pod output waiting for finish must reach r_pod x pod-hours before the pool grows (10-31: r_pod 7.7, plan 7, 382 gave 2 talks in ~50 min, 386 rented); st.pods_output shows out_h, pure_h, published_rate_h. (2) media-scan #60829 held siftersearch-media 'draining' 21 min, so the remaster lane stopped and the reaper closed pods 382/386; the scan now yields between files (known files are skipped on the re-run). (3) migration 193 idx_media_source_ref: findMediaBySource scanned the table, ~155 ms per file. Test: 485's meta shape (held, original listening, verify/quiet skipped) is not complete

An unpublished talk (restored ≠ 1) gives no clips: /clip-url, /clip and the moment card 404 to the public, like its page and files. 10-31: talk 485 (remaster held for a measured regression, nisqa_down; its web copy is the original, listening 'safe') was 404 on its page and files, but /clip-url handed out a signed URL and /clip served 30 s of the original audio (HTTP 200, 260 kB) to anyone with the slug

The edge Worker modules tower also imports (worker/queue/core.js, worker/dewey-upload.js) are runtime code. 10-31: e14c272f changed only worker/queue/core.js (the queue core behind the LAN queue and the pod plan) and was pulled "touching no runtime code — no reload", so siftersearch-media kept the old plan. A test walks api/ and scripts/ for imports of worker/ and fails on any not listed

A re-transcription off the worker never erases measured coverage, and a talk can be sent through the worker chain again (media-cloud-order mode 'whole', explicit ids only). 10-31: the tower-side transcribe redo of 1947 wrote asr.coverage null, the publish gate read "not measured = no problem" and published a 221-word transcript of a 58-min talk whose worker measurement had 259 holes. Now such a redo records coverage {unmeasured} and publishing blocks until a whole redo measures it in the worker. Tests cover both
A talk missing only finish stages goes to cpu-finish, never back to gpu; gpu re-runs only when the pure remaster input is gone (have.pure false) or remaster never ran

Whole bootstrap exports the image's LD_LIBRARY_PATH (ssh sessions lack it → sherpa CUDA couldn't load libcublasLt.so.12, every 'unsure' talk failed at diarize after its GPU remaster); diarize falls back to CPU if the CUDA provider can't load
Edge job queue — CF Worker hands out jobs, one image everywhere, results via R2 (Chad 10-30)
Collect results in the background, a finished talk frees its slot (10-30: pods ran at 1/3-1/4)

The stage ledger (Chad 10-30: "a lightweight sqlite table managing the stages of each staged or published audio file") — media_stages (migr 190), one row per (talk, stage), mirrored from meta.json at every save + whole/cloud results; media-ledger-reconcile report walks every folder and reports drift. Internal API /api/admin/ops/media/{progress,items,items/:ref,items/:id/redo} + ops.mjs media …; Dewey tools media_progress, media_status

Send audio, never video (Chad 10-30: "pushing video around to process audio is simply absurd") — a video original's audio track is stream-copied (ffmpeg -vn -c:a copy, bit for bit, tower 'light') before it goes to R2 or a pod; whole recordings keep their file (input_sha). The stager now stages only what pods may take (it had staged held-back whole mp4s: pulls 0, direct 8)
The lane's 60 s heartbeat saves its state too (10-30: a pass collecting results ran 9+ min unsaved — staging progress and new jobs invisible)

A drain waits at most 30 s for home jobs (10-30: an ssh boss start that ignored the stop held the lane 7+ min — no state written, 3 pods starved); staged R2 objects re-staged after 36 h, before the 2-day bucket rule deletes them

Stage ahead in R2 (Chad 10-30) — the lane uploads queued originals to R2 continuously, ~100 audio-hours ahead, pods up or not; a pod pulls its input from a signed URL in seconds (direct upload stays the fallback). Uploads still in flight count as work, so the lane no longer closes a pod or ends while one is being assigned. Summary shows staged talks/h/GB, pulls vs direct

Uploads run in the background — the pass no longer waits on them (10-30: 12 at once over tower's ~18 Mbit/s real uplink made one pass 10 min, so no results came back and no pod was fed). 2 per pod, 4 in all; a .part still being sent is not requeued as a leftover

Stage ahead so pods never starve (Chad 10-30) — each pod is kept at its worker's slots + 4 waiting, up to 4 uploads sent at once per pass and 3 results fetched; one-at-a-time held a 12-slot 4090 to ~4 jobs (13-15 min cycle for ~6 min of work) while tower's link sat at 15 of 1000 Mbit/s. saveState tmp names are unique so concurrent stagings don't clobber
The capacity report's maxPods now sets the pod count both ways — it could only lower the lane's launch request, so a lane started at 2 ignored the operator's 3
The reaper's 'finished a talk recently' check matched done by pod id, but done records the pod by name — it spared nothing; match either

The reaper no longer takes a working pod as 'GPU quiet (stuck)' — pod 350 read 0 % GPU for an hour while finishing 8 talks in 30 min (sampling misses the short GPU bursts) and was reaped; a pod that finished a talk within the quiet window is spared
Clearing a decision clears its note and decider too

New pods no longer end themselves before their first talk — the image's worker self-ended after 120 s idle / 3 min without a tower heartbeat, and tower's first look at a warming pod comes a lane tick (~3.5 min) later (351-353 all closed 'unreachable'); the worker now runs without RUNPOD_POD_ID and a keeper script holds the safety nets (tower silent 30 min, 24 h life); speech-coverage check (worker-only, refuses on tower) gates publishing; ops-reports names test lists media-cloud-capacity + media-quiet-repair

Rent 32 vCPUs first and scale max_jobs with vCPU (the worker runs min(max_jobs, vCPU/2); #349's 18 vCPUs left 7 jobs in CPU post and the GPU at 0 %); the reaper spares a productive pod past 8 h (hard cap 24 h; pod-side cap 24 h for the next image); a pod the reaper took is closed as 'reaped: <why>', not 'unreachable'; /media machine cards compact so six fit one row

An item whose mode is 'withdraw' is never work — intake withdraws on mode too, each tick drops any already queued (193 withdraw orders taken in by the pre-withdraw lane sat in the queue as items); media-quiet-repair takes back the published talks a withdrawn redo left 'waiting' (no valid worker result) and returns them to done
Withdraw orders (media-cloud-order mode 'withdraw'); a talk running on a home host counts as running — for pulling back the 218 restore redos in favour of a silence-only repair of the kept masters
A home host that stops answering keeps its task (2 min rest, re-attach by job id); only the 3rd strike requeues — boss ran 663/667 while the lane called it unreachable and sent 663 to a pod too
'host unreachable' keeps the error text that tripped it (boss was benched with no reason recorded)
Words timed past the end of the copy no longer make negative stretches
Silence the word-free stretches — UniPASE turns background-only audio into loud noise (believers-memories: 0-10 s at -10 dB)
Click the version tag to copy it (shows 'copied ✓'); no longer navigates home
Pod count + spend cap set through ops (media-cloud-capacity → data/run/cloud-capacity.json; capUsd there wins over MEDIA_CLOUD_CAP_USD), bounded and tested
Cloud orders can go FIRST — talks taken off the air (reverted for splicing) lead the lane queue whatever their mode; queue order is one tested function (laneOrder)
A talk without a passed remaster has no published state — its page JSON and files 404 to the public (internal key still reads them; pod ensure sends it)
Web audio streams from R2 while it uploads — pieces (512 KB first, then 4 MB), a read waits only for its piece; a GET miss starts the copy; the page warms both copies
Worker verdict and public readout drop 'partial' — any sentence from the original is 'spliced', never counted as restored
NEVER A SPLICE — a remaster with any sentence from the original is never published ('spliced' verdict; 'partial' removed)
Media-cloud-order post lists talks with no restored copy on tower (no_copy) — those need a full redo to be re-assessed
Quality report counts publishable remasters with/without a passed listening assessment (+ unassessed list)
Verify parses -inf/'through' levels and names the failing measure; ops.mjs run <id>
Media-remaster-review-pack honours ids and skips a talk whose clip fails instead of failing the job
Failures — failed ops jobs queryable (GET /ops/failures, ops.mjs failures) so FAILED mails need not be pasted
Verify stage — a remaster must be measurably different from the original, or it is held for review and is never complete/on air
Box sets order unnumbered recordings into the unclaimed part slots; bare trailing slug number is a part
Remastered/hr counts COMPLETIONS (completed_at, migration 188), not first publications
Dewey-upload resume — pause only after the good parts land (race)
Index stages + audio quality (migration 187): stages_missing, next_stage, verdict, NISQA in/out, bandwidth in/out; backfill + per-stage maintenance
Media-stages report/job — per-talk missing stages, queue exactly those (or forced redo) through the engine
On air = COMPLETE (all stages done + passed remaster assessment); flag recomputed after every stage
On air = real remaster only (heavy/cleaned), not the bulk light tier; re-verify rows flagged under the looser rule
Restored-only on-air, machine-agnostic host registry, page-open edge warm
Browser triage tool for big copied drives (catalog, suggestions, decisions, Dewey import)
Archives sift plan and handoff (design only, no code)
Boss whole status, hipFFT open bug
Capability-ranked slots (EWMA per host), boss whole admission from measured peak, aorus container start needs host RAM
HyPE core batch status 10-28
Worker image / AMD GPU status and handoff
F16 reconcile as a streaming merge-diff (JS Set caps at 16.7M entries)
No book is imported without Chad approval - books and documents stop at offered everywhere (fetch, upload, ZIP, pulse, folder sweep); trust and rights default apply to media only
Whole orders need 8 GB VRAM free on the GPU host
:rocm image fixes (matching ROCm userspace, MIOpen headers + cache), design update
Supersede path - replace a talk source audio, keep the old original and meta under original-superseded/vN, revert any time
RAM defer lane for write-and-forget batches (30 s), 25 ms group window, checkpoint 300 s; flushed on power flush and shutdown
AMD GPU worker path - whisper.cpp HIP ASR, :rocm image, host admission (refuse without proven GPU), boss whole orders, one host per order
Repoint batch children to working source URLs (ops endpoint); sidecar records page and real source URL
Contributors are trusted - rights default asserted, clean works added without asking, 100 auto-adds/contributor/day
Plain downloads run on tower (siftersearch-dewey-fetch, bulk slice, fetch only); worker accepts DEPLOY_SECRET and DEWEY_OPS
Import mediaFindJob in reports.js (media-find registration referenced it unimported)
Add remaining ASR bench scripts
ASR engine benchmark harness (whisper.cpp HIP wins on boss: WER 2.7-8.3%, RTF 0.023-0.05)
Import readFileSync for /latency io counters
Skip no-op UPDATE of reused paragraphs; writer /latency exposes process io counters
Qdrant scripts default to QDRANT_URL (so one env var moves the engine); f16 recall check script
Qram units snapshot to /faster/qram-snapshots (drop-ins as installed on tower)
No more CD-style spinning portraits — portraits are still; playing = a quiet pulsing ring; hover spins/tilts on disc portraits removed; reduced motion = none
Update expected report names list (13 added by other agents)
A same-hash second file is a duplicate, not a move (watcher flipped paths every scan, dirtying paragraphs: 99% of writer bytes); same-shelf rename does not dirty
F16 build in 8 paragraph_id shards (one node thread + one qdrant connection thread each capped at ~1k pts/s)
Design note — one hardware-adaptive worker image, HTTP inputs for pods, tower-assign + pull results
F16 build health probe is /healthz (404 on /api/health made the guard wait forever); reject unknown modes

Boss is two memory pools — the monitor reads system RAM, PSI pressure, zram, VRAM, GTT, GPU busy/temp, per-process VRAM and service memory; guards admit by VRAM free + MemAvailable + pressure; docs/ops/boss-memory.md
Point the f16 build at phrase-vector-read-repo
Restore phrase-store-repo (clobbered), vectors.db f16 reader is phrase-vector-read-repo
SIGKILL / rsync timeouts also mean an unreachable host (aorus offline: its talks used attempts)
Phrase-f16-build job (phrases main+hot -> float16 collection on qdrant-main /faster), vectors.db read repo, qdrant-main unit

Boss memory safety — every gate job in a hard cgroup (capped.sh: MemoryMax, no swap, oom_score_adj 900), CPU-tail container 6 GB x 1 with a RAM check, 13 GB MemAvailable reserve checked live before any boss job
Logical bytes per caller x name (per-thread wchar split by payload) in db_write_stats, /stats and write-stats report
An unreachable home host rests 10 min and its talk goes back to the front without using an attempt (boss went offline: 41 talks burned their attempts)
Audio tags (ID3/MP4/Vorbis) as hints for speaker, title, series; media-hint-review report and media-tags-backfill job

Boss restores D/E talks (UniPASE on its ROCm iGPU + the worker-image CPU tail) beside aorus's whole imports; boss heat limits 96/99/93 (measured: no throttling at 90-92 C); media-cloud-order backfill mode, worst grade first
Drain excess rentals when the uplink limits throughput
Keep unfinished stages queued under worker backpressure
Survive worker backpressure and persist rental allocations
Bound transfer batches so rental workers stay fed
Keep GPU work buffered through long postprocessing tails
Keep rental workers observable during long jobs
Slim image on the official pytorch runtime base (no nightly-torch duplicate: 64 GB -> ~25 GB), ssh entrypoint with zombie guards, local image test harness, docker-data-room host check
Descriptive titles for the six untitled Chad Jones talks (from their summaries and chapters); jones-01 unchanged
Hide of jones-01-thursday cancelled (Chad 10-25) — decision restore
Reversible hide — talk decisions by slug, edge purge after exclude, media-restore job (decision 'restore'); jones-01-thursday hidden for now (Chad 10-25), restore command in planning/media-hidden.md
The remastering demo link is a compact pill above the hero (one link, above the fold; the lower card is gone)
Per-data-centre boot times and wasted rent in the ledger; rentals prefer the data centres that booted fast and worked, SECURE after a breaker trip
Lane keeper (the cloud lane always comes back), non-sticky money stop, canary-first rental with a 3-strike circuit breaker and wasted-$ ledger, image selftest
Pods without the gate are retired after their jobs (MEDIA_POOL_REQUIRE_GATE); only gate pods join the pool

Rented pods join the worker pool as hosts of the same gate — prep (probe, grade, dfn) and every web / trim-window encode dispatch to pods, aorus and boss; image carries the gate (venv, DeepFilterNet venv, cached Whisper + DNSMOS/NISQA)
The tower gate in CLAUDE.md

Tower never runs heavy media work — a central gate in tools.js: dfn/grade/diarize/transcribe/realign/langid/probe/guard/prep-encodes WAIT for a worker (item back in the queue), web encodes one at a time, light analysis two
4 talks in flight per pod with a fair share (GPU is ~70 s of a ~12 min cycle: uploads, the CPU half and downloads overlap the next talks)
Explicit redo orders (restore mode) re-run talks the first pass got wrong
The worker finds the BAKED aligners (HF_HOME was unset in the ssh-started worker: every Persian talk 'placed 0 words' and was held)
Dewey-discard can be limited to one member via the by param
Dead-worker detection starts its clock on the first status read (a state file carrying an old status never tripped it)

A pod whose worker stopped is replaced (it idled itself out and then took jobs for an hour: nothing completed); the pod's terminate call sends a User-Agent (urllib's got 403); per-talk cycle timings recorded
